On the guidance point, `ISTRESS-ROLLOUT-MONITORING-006-HF-CONTENT` and `ISTRESS-ROLLOUT-MONITORING-006-NIST-MEASURE` do not override the internal predicate, but they do support the narrower framing that documented limitations plus active measurement and monitoring are legitimate parts of a deployment decision.
